Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Great liberated souls of ancient times performed their duties in this spirit of detachment; Arjuna is encouraged to follow their example and fulfill his responsibilities in divine consciousness.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Arjuna's inclination to abandon his active duties out of confusion and distress.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna advises: 'evam jnatva krtam karma purvair api mumuksubhih, kuru karmaiva tasmat tvam purvaih purvataram krtam' (Ancient seekers of liberation worked with this understanding; therefore, perform your duty as the ancients did).
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna is inspired to embrace duty actively, relying on proven historical and spiritual precedents.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Following Tested Models: Drawing confidence from the successful practices of predecessors
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Fulfilling Duty with Purpose: Carrying out responsibilities with clear ethical intent
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Active Engagement Over Avoidance: Facing life's duties directly instead of withdrawing out of fear

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Evam jnatva krtam karma (Acting with this understanding of detachment)
Purvair api mumuksubhih (By ancient seekers of liberation)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Liberated souls throughout history attained freedom not by abandoning work, but by acting with spiritual understanding; Arjuna is urged to follow their path.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Avoidance of duty leads to stagnation; following established examples of purposeful action helps maintain focus and personal fulfillment.
